Sver the Trapper

Overview

Sver the Trapper knows the local Woodsfolk and the requirements for approaching the Green Clan. He helps the travellers interpret events around the supposedly valuable caravan and identifies an ice elemental as the next lead for the magician. His practical advice links several stages of the Ingos investigation. [1, 2]

Two magicians on Ingos

Kir and Kel seek magical help on Ingos. Karansul complains about Yam-Akara, whose cheap runes undercut his trade, and identifies His as the governor’s court magician. His receives the travellers with suspicion and later asks them to retrieve materials from his laboratory. Sver the Trapper offers another route: contact Grey Leaf through the Sacred Flower and a vessel from his cache. Grey Leaf explains that the knight Brissen and his magician friend have left for the settlement near the mines. Kir’s first task here is finding an informed ally, before the murder that later dominates the investigation. [3, 4, 1, 5, 6, 7]

The Beastmasters and the empty caravan

At the Beastmasters’ settlement, Crooked accuses Kir and Kel of being spies. Geraldine agrees to test them. Their attempt to obtain a gold nugget from a caravan finds an empty chest, making their return dangerous. Trickster reasons that genuine thieves would not come back empty-handed, and Geraldine accepts them. Sver’s advice about an ice elemental in the abandoned mines provides something to offer Yam-Akara. His work and the governor’s permit requirements then draw the travellers into further dealings with the court. The missing nugget will matter again when the apparent caravan failure becomes evidence of a separate theft. [8, 9, 2, 10, 11]
